icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one production-ready 2D strategy-game icon, isolated on genuinely transparent alpha background. Create a logging camp that unmistakably PRODUCES LOGS, not a house with a badge. Inspired by the clean, colorful, low-poly shapes and warm materials of Kenney City Kit / Survival Kit, but deliberately DRAWN 2D vector-like illustration with flat polygon color planes, no actual 3D rendering appearance. Three-quarter orthographic view, see front and right sides, top-left light expressed only in 3 flat tones. Main silhouette: compact triangular stack of THREE oversized round-cut brown logs in a sturdy low timber rack, one tall simple evergreen at back-left, a large chopping stump with axe embedded at front-right. The logs occupy over half the visual mass. This is a functional outdoor timber production site, absolutely no house, roof or detached pictogram. Simplify brutally for legibility at 48px: 4-6 bold connected shapes, no tiny detail, no foliage clusters, no textures, no outlines, no gradients, no realistic shadows, no landscape base, no circular badge, no text, no frames. Warm terracotta wood #BA754B, pale honey endgrain #E6B87B, foliage green #57915A, steel slate #78929E. Consistent compact square mass within center 80% of square canvas, crisp edges, transparent generous margin. Reference image is STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY, do not reproduce its empty shed.
